# Security policy

## Reporting a problem

If you find a security problem in VNext, please don't open an issue or a discussion: report it privately with **Report a vulnerability** on the [Security tab](https://github.com/zsande/VNext/security). Only you and I see it there.

Say what it is, how to make it happen (a small game that does it is best) and which version of VNext you used (the first line of About names it). For example: a game that makes VNext read or write files outside its own folders, or crash in a way someone could take over.

I'll answer there, and the fix comes out in a new release. Once it's out, the report can be made public, with thanks to you if you like.

## Versions

Only the latest release gets fixes, so check that it still happens there.
